rule: Bridge for two. The first 13 tricks are a no-trump draw: winning one scores nothing, and after each trick the winner then the loser draws a card. Once the 26-card stock is gone both hands are back to 13 and the auction begins. A contract needs 6 + level tricks. Making it scores level x 10 plus 5 per overtrick; going down gives the opponent 10 per trick short.
